summary: Modular monolith: ASP.NET Core + Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL serving Vue + Vite (SPA), hosted on Google Cloud Run (us-central1 Iowa). Estimated $60-250/month (around the $100 budget).

architecture_rationale.text: One deployable with strict internal modules for the marketplace domain (e.g. bookings, providers, chat, payments): a 2-engineer team gets clear boundaries without distributed-system overhead; modules can be extracted later if scale demands it. Over-engineering guard: microservices rejected: 2 engineer(s), no DevOps cannot absorb the operational overhead.

frontend.justification: Web - Vue + Vite (SPA): Chosen because strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=3; rich client-side interactivity for a marketplace; strong maintainability (4/5) with priorities.maintainability=3; strong performance (4/5) with priorities.performance=3.

alternatives.why_not: Vue + Vite scores higher on learning curve (fit 4.7 vs 5.1).
Vue + Vite scores higher on cost and operational simplicity (fit 4.5 vs 5.1).

backend.justification: Chosen because strong maintainability (5/5) with priorities.maintainability=3; strong performance (5/5) with priorities.performance=3; strong scalability (5/5) with priorities.scalability=3; strong security (5/5) with priorities.security=3.

alternatives.why_not: ASP.NET Core scores higher on performance and scalability (fit 5.5 vs 6.6).
ASP.NET Core scores higher on performance and scalability (fit 4.8 vs 6.6).

database.choice: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL (us-central1 Iowa, HA standby)
database.justification: Chosen because relational integrity and transactions for a marketplace domain; strong maintainability (5/5) with priorities.maintainability=3; strong security (5/5) with priorities.security=3; strong cost efficiency (4/5) with priorities.cost=3. Managed as Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL: same platform and private network as the application hosting; fully managed: no operations work for a team without DevOps.

alternatives.why_not: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL scores higher on maintainability and security (fit 5.5 vs 6.2).
Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL scores higher on maintainability and security (fit 5.1 vs 6.2).
Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL scores higher on integration with the hosting platform (fit 0.2 vs 2.1).
Excluded by hard constraint: deployment_model=managed_cloud: self-managed VMs/databases are excluded in favour of managed services.

tradeoffs: Single-writer primary: write scale beyond one large node needs partitioning/sharding
Vacuum and connection pooling need attention at scale
Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL starts around $48/month against a $100/month total budget

hosting.justification: Chosen because strong cost efficiency (5/5) with priorities.cost=3; strong scalability (5/5) with priorities.scalability=3; strong security (5/5) with priorities.security=3; runs the ASP.NET Core (.NET 10 LTS) container as-is.

alternatives.why_not: Google Cloud Run scores higher on cost and scalability (fit 5.5 vs 6.0).
Google Cloud Run scores higher on cost and scalability (fit 5.3 vs 6.0).
Excluded by hard constraint: deployment_model=managed_cloud is not on-premise.

tradeoffs: Session affinity is best-effort for stateful rooms

supporting.justification: Chosen because same cloud/platform and region as the application; strong performance (5/5) with priorities.performance=3; strong scalability (5/5) with priorities.scalability=3; strong security (5/5) with priorities.security=3.

alternatives.why_not: Google Cloud CDN scores higher on integration with the hosting platform (fit 5.0 vs 6.0).
